Class Rng

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Random
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides random number generation utilities, including weighted selection, random values, and seeded randomness.

Constructors

Rng()

Initializes a new instance of the Rng class with a time-based seed.

public Rng()

Remarks

Seed is generated according to the following formula:

Seed = DateTime.Now.Millisecond * Environment.TickCount;

Rng(int)

Initializes a new instance of the Rng class using the specified seed value.

public Rng(int seed)

Parameters

seed int

A number used to calculate a starting value for the pseudo-random number sequence. If a negative number is specified, the absolute value of the number is used.
